title: 10 Best Anime to Watch on Netflix in June 2026
content: May 2026 is right around the corner, which means anime fans need another list of exciting series and films to watch. Luckily, Netflix ‘s library is expanding by the day, and there are several exciting stories fans can explore each month.
author: ComicBook

title: 18 Years Later, One of The Greatest Manga of All Time Is Finally Making Its Anticipated Debut
content: After years of fans asking for a higher quality version of what is possibly one of the best anime made, they have been answered as the legendary Monster series is finally being released in Blu-ray version soon, courtesy of Discotek Media .
author: ComicBook

title: Light Novel 'Haibara-kun no Tsuyokute Seishun New Game' Concludes
content: Kazuki Amamiya 's Haibara-kun no Tsuyokute Seishun New Game ( Haibara's Teenage New Game+ ) light novel ended its main story with the 11th volume on Monday. The 12th volume, featuring an epilogue focused on the characters' third year of high school to wrap up their youth, is planned for a 2027 release.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Solo Leveling Confirms Exciting Update For Its Biggest New Project Amid Season 3 Delay
content: Solo Leveling premiered its highly anticipated Season 2 last year as part of the Winter 2025 lineup and adapted the best arc of the story. The latest season was a rollercoaster of emotions as Jinwoo finally managed to wake his mother up from her eternal slumber.
author: ComicBook

title: Studio Ghibli Confirms Major New Release Fans Can’t Miss
content: For decades since its establishment in 1985, Studio Ghibli has remained the most iconic animation studio when it comes to anime movies. Every film produced by the studio is famous for its striking visuals, rich storytelling, and deep emotional impact.
author: ComicBook

title: Mitsuri Kanroji From Demon Slayer Gets Special 2026 Birthday Illustration by Ufotable
content: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba revealed a new special 2026 illustration by ufotable for Mitsuri Kanroji, whose birthday is on June 1. The studio frequently marks such occasions with commemorative art, with Mitsuri also getting a special artwork last year .
author: Anime Corner

title: Major Shonen Jump Manga Announces Extended Hiatus At The Last Minute
content: Unlike the famous Weekly Shonen Jump manga by Shueisha, the Jump SQ. magazine from the same publisher isn’t even a decade old. However, it has introduced readers to some of the most incredible manga of all time.
author: ComicBook

title: Sakura Wars Game Franchise Gets 3rd Stage Play Adaptation
content: Sega 's Shin Sakura Taisen game is getting a new stage play adaptation titled Shin Sakura Taisen the Stage: Seiden Tsurugi (New Sakura Wars the Stage: Tale of Truth Tsurugi), which will run at Theater Sun Mall in Tokyo from September 18 - 27. title: 5 Shonen Anime Protagonists You’d Never Want to Meet in Real Life
content: Anime protagonists, especially those from the shonen genre, often possess heroic qualities that are genuinely inspiring. It would not be an overstatement to say that they feel like real heroes, people we would want to admire, idolize, and look up to.

title: The Apothecary Diaries Creator Debunks Major Fan Theory (& Reveals Maomao’s Surprise Origin)
content: The Apothecary Diaries has had a major fan theory debunked by the original creator behind it all, and it even included a surprising reveal about the original idea behind Maomao’s character too.
